parked_completed_postings_gate._comment: Controller ruling 2 offered TWO real-cost paths for Papers for Pallass Stage 1 ('sponsor'): '10g filing fee OR a completed-postings record gate'. Only the 10g fee path is LIVE (data/dialogue/selys_delivery.json's pallass_sponsor node). The alternate is PARKED, not implemented -- STOP-trigger condition per the phase brief.
parked_completed_postings_gate.why_parked: Traced every existing 'completed a posting' producer in the sim: WIGame.turn_in_bounty banks completed_bounty_<id>, WIGame.turn_in_delivery banks completed_delivery_<id> -- both PER-ID counters, keyed to one specific bounty/delivery. No aggregate 'total postings completed' counter exists anywhere (accomplishment_count() only reads exact-match keys, no wildcard/prefix summing helper). WIQuests.QUEST_COMPLETED is an event only, never banked as an accomplishment counter either.
parked_completed_postings_gate.why_not_added_here: Adding an aggregate counter (e.g. incrementing a new postings_completed key inside turn_in_bounty/turn_in_delivery) would be a SECOND new-sim addition beyond the plan's own ONE sanctioned addition (the race-variant key, ruling 3). The phase brief's own STOP trigger names this exact scenario: 'the completed-postings counter doesn't exist and would need new tracking.'
options_for_controller: Sanction the small aggregate-counter addition (2 call sites in wi_game.gd: turn_in_bounty/turn_in_delivery each gain one extra record_accomplishment('postings_completed') line) as a follow-up task, then wire the alternate sponsorship path against it.

Retire the alternate path from the plan -- ship Papers for Pallass Stage 1 as the single 10g-fee path (already live), since EVERY quest-path-cost rule (wi-adding-dialogue-and-quests SKILL.md) only requires ONE real cost per stage, not two alternate ones.

Repurpose an EXISTING single counter as a narrower proxy (e.g. gate on one specific high-visibility bounty's completed_bounty_<id>) -- rejected here as a worse fit than either option above (doesn't represent 'a record of postings' generically, and privileges one arbitrary posting).
